_about: Worked example for chapters.py: the card and sub-chapter positions of the REA video master (a 20-minute talking-head + screen-recording tutorial). Times are ms on the master timeline, read from the live project right before export. Card text and chapter text differ on purpose: the card says 'Why This Matters', the description says 'Why It Matters'; level cards never say 'Level N' on screen, the description adds it. Running `chapters.py --config chapters.example.json` prints the block that shipped with that master (0:00 Intro, 1:45 Why It Matters, 3:49 ..., 15:57 Why Open Source Wins).
